body.statement: The paper-specific covariance and threshold rates are attainable in two concrete regimes. First, if \(X\) has fixed finite support with every support mass bounded below, the foldwise cell-frequency covariance of the cross-fitted \(\widehat R\) has \(r_{\Gamma,n}=n^{-1/2}+r_{p,n}+r_{m,n}\) in \(L_4(P_X)\); all conditional expectations in Definition \(\ref{def:gap-one-step}\) are estimated by the corresponding cell averages. With parametric first stages and \(\tau_n=n^{-a}\), any \(0<a<1/4\) gives consistent rank recovery and \(r_{b,n}=O(n^{-1/2+a})\). Second, suppose \(X\in[0,1]^{d_X}\) has density bounded above and away from zero, every entry of \(\Gamma\) and every conditional expectation displayed in Definition \(\ref{def:gap-one-step}\), uniformly over \(j\le J_n\), lies in a common \(\beta_{\Gamma}\)-Hölder ball with \(\beta_{\Gamma}>d_X/2\), and the conditional fourth-moment envelope holds. A tensor-spline or compactly supported wavelet least-squares estimator with \(J_{\Gamma,n}\asymp n^{d_X/(2\beta_{\Gamma}+d_X)}\) then gives \[r_{\Gamma,n}=O\!\left(n^{-\beta_{\Gamma}/(2\beta_{\Gamma}+d_X)}+r_{p,n}+r_{m,n}\right).\] If \(J_nJ_{\Gamma,n}/n\to0\), the same regressions make the projected-score sample equations and all coordinates of \(\widehat g_{\Delta,J_n}\) consistent. When first-stage errors do not dominate and \(\tau_n=r_{\Gamma,n}^{a}\) for any \(0<a<1/2-d_X/(4\beta_{\Gamma})\), the selected rank is consistent, \(r_{b,n}=O(r_{\Gamma,n}^{1-a})\), and the quadratic covariance/loading condition holds. In either regime, the mixed condition follows whenever \(r_{p,n}+r_{m,n}=o(n^{-1/2}/r_{b,n})\).
body.justification: The abstract rate conditions are credible only if familiar discrete-cell and smooth-regression learners deliver them with explicit tuning ranges.
body.gap: Chen, Sant'Anna, and Xie (2025) do not estimate the full shared-cell DDD conditional covariance in \(L_4(P_X)\); this proposition supplies paper-specific sufficient regimes rather than attributing that rate to their DiD theorem.
body.consumer: Implementers can select either cell-frequency covariance estimates for discrete covariates or a transparent smooth series learner for continuous covariates.
